title: BACKND Base implementation guideline (step-by-step)
summary: Step-by-step onboarding guideline that stitches core BACKND Base features into end-to-end flows (new-user signup/login/nickname, game-information, rank, chart, post, coupon, game-log, friend, guild), each with copyable all-code samples.
capabilities: route end-to-end 'how do I implement X' questions to a guided walkthrough
sequence prerequisite steps such as init and login before a feature
point to all-code sample pages for a feature flow
distinguish guideline walkthroughs from per-function reference topics
prerequisites: SDK is installed and initialized (see startup and sdk-initialize)
A login flow is in place before feature-specific steps
common_pitfalls: Treating guideline sample code as the exact current API instead of verifying the feature topic
Skipping the init and login prerequisite steps the guideline assumes
Following the rank walkthrough for new work instead of the current leaderboard topic
verification_required_for: exact sample code and method names
whether a walkthrough step matches the current feature API
verification_strategy: Use https://docs.backnd.com plus the source route, and cross-check the matching reference topic before copying sample code.
Prefer the leaderboard topic over the guideline rank walkthrough for new ranking work.
public_notes: Guideline pages are onboarding walkthroughs, not the API reference; verify exact calls against the feature topic.
This topic improves routing for end-to-end implementation questions.
